scientific_question: Can candidate-specific detection calibration required by v5 be reconstructed from already-existing supplementary or raw data without opening focal cross-role outcomes?

reconstruction_gates.R1_calibration_stream_exists: A distinct existing observation stream must compare the focal detector/resource scorer against a higher-coverage or repeated reference observation on the same units/windows.
reconstruction_gates.R2_same_unit_same_window_alignment: Calibration and candidate detector/scorer must overlap on the same biological units and relevant time windows.
reconstruction_gates.R3_reference_not_defined_by_focal_outcom: The gold-standard or repeated reference labels must not be derived from fruit, emergence, or the focal cross-role outcome.
reconstruction_gates.R4_failure_missingness_separable: Device failure, out-of-frame periods, missing records, and unavailable files must be distinguishable from confirmed biological absence.
reconstruction_gates.R5_performance_estimable: Sensitivity, false-negative rate, and specificity or an equivalent prespecified detection-performance quantity must be estimable from existing data.
reconstruction_gates.R6_v5_thresholds_met: Reconstructed performance must satisfy sensitivity >= 0.80, hard FNR <= 0.20, and specificity >= 0.95 before any empirical endpoint opening.

candidate_specific_reconstruction_target.CREMV3-007: same-inflorescence overlapping sensor-camera versus continuous_or_scheduled_reference observations with effective-pollinator labels independent of fruit outcome
candidate_specific_reconstruction_target.BELV3-012: same-tree repeated_or_cross_observer budbreak/resource scoring across the full relevant window with explicit missing-versus-confirmed-absence states
